`core/Plugin/files.jsonl:10` adds `{"file":"failures.jsonl","gone":true}` while `failures.jsonl` is still listed on line 1 and line 9 and still exists on disk; the index now contradicts itself, so a fresh agent cannot tell whether the file is wanted. Keep one `failures.jsonl` line and drop the "gone" line.

`core/Plugin/doc/design-notes.md:16` still says live instances are tracked only for a plugin that defines its own `detach`; `Plugin.js` `enable` now also tracks any plugin with `fields` or config defaults (`configurable`), and `reconcile` tracks any instance forced on. Update that line (and the per-instance cost) so the doc matches the code.

`Host.make_default(inst)` in `Plugin.js:105-127` that turns a plugin ON at the class only calls `enable`, which hooks future instances; other already-open instances never get it (the re-attach loop at line 121 skips any instance whose `attached` set lacks the name). Requirements ask that "Make default" change the defaults, and plan.md step 5 says other open chats follow, so either attach such instances in `make_default` or write the limit in the readme and add a test.

`Plugin.js:121-122` re-attaches every other tracked instance (detach, run) even when that instance has its own config override, so a plugin churns for no change; harmless in tests but an unneeded detach/attach for a Voice Chat plugin like barge-in mid-speech.

`Plugin.js:56` (`state.over[rec.name]?.enabled === false` inside the "new" hook) can never be true, because `plugin_data` is created fresh on that same call; it is dead code the next agent will puzzle over.

Simpler path: the plan stores overrides only on the instance, which is right and small; the extra `configurable` and `all_records` machinery is the one growth area, so keep it out of the Voice Chat plugins by always writing config through `set_plugin`.

Doc counts check out (readme "24 tests" = 13 old + 11 new; all 24 pass in worktree qf-4), and the readme "Per instance" section is accurate to the code; shots only cover the framework index and core/Plugin page at 1920, which this change does not alter visually.
